'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Moritz Karge DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Moritz Karge]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Moritz Karge]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
